A '''water filtration kit''' was an easily available product that could be purchased in major [[City/Legends|cities]] and [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]]. They cost forty-five [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and were used to filter [[Water/Legends|water]].<ref name="Game">''[[Gamemaster Toolkit: Live-Action Adventures]]''</ref>
